description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] to party, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Aranea)], [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
